# Jonah Kessler-Cohen

> A Seattle-based filmmaker and social media video producer at Loyola Marymount University. His work ranges from satire to documentary to branded content. Aside from projects, he's a moose enthusiast and a casual rock climber.

- Undergraduate at [Loyola Marymount University](https://lmu.edu/), double majoring in Marketing and in Film and Television Production (class of 2029).
- Currently a video/photo intern at [Sound Transit](https://www.soundtransit.org/) (Summer 2026).
- Generated 25M+ views across social media accounts he's run.
- Adobe Certified Professional in Premiere Pro; 6+ years editing in Final Cut Pro X.

## Portfolio

Top three projects, ranked by personal favorite; full descriptions and additional projects at [jonahkc.com](https://jonahkc.com/).

- [T-Mobile Club](https://instagram.com/tmobileclub): Founded a high school fan club that led to a [Deutsche Telekom collaboration](https://www.wuv.de/Themen/Marke/Wie-die-Telekom-aus-einem-Highschool-Club-eine-geniale-Werbeaktion-macht) producing content for their global social accounts, a [birthday video](https://youtu.be/8YlqmjaFrho) shown at their leadership conference, and a T-Mobile HQ tour.
- [Is there a whale season?](https://youtu.be/3qHCwG9p4Vw): Short documentary made as a college application film, filmed with his grandmother on Orcas Island.
- [Lincoln Cheer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Y4-djfYv54&list=PLDPmDQKU3LUAW8Y28nw6cG_7TZ7_99eaW&index=1): Docuseries following his high school's cheer team. He directed a crew across two weeks of daily practices and a state competition trip, and edited 100+ hours of footage into a 37-minute series; the trailer hit 440K+ views on TikTok.
